text:
sanjay: Heads up — since 08:22 UTC we're seeing a sharp spike in outbound fails from edge-proxy (eu-west-1). App logs are full of ECONNRESET and 502s hitting model-registry.svc. Cloud metrics show a single NATGW (nat-0a1b2c3d) ephemeral ports at 98% used.
ops-bot: Incident INC-4821 created for eu-west-1 egress errors :rotating_light:
maya: I'm looking at conntrack/TIME_WAIT on the sidecars — TIME_WAIT is piling up, ~45k entries on a handful of nodes. Most originate from short-lived model pulls.
eli: Are the model clients using keepalive? If every pull opens a new TCP connection we'll hit ephemeral port limits fast.
lina: We shipped a change yesterday that toggles keepalive off in the Java client (to avoid stuck threads). Rolling that back now.
derrick: Quick mitigation options: add another NAT per AZ (extra cost), or spin up an egress proxy pool to reuse sockets. Long term we need pooling + local cache.
maya: Short-term fixes I can push: 1) re-enable keepalive on the client; 2) tune conntrack on sidecars/nodes; 3) increase ip_local_port_range as a bandaid.
sanjay: Can you paste the exact sysctl/commands?
maya: Sure — for nodes/sidecar hosts: 
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range="1024 65535"
```
Also check TIME_WAIT: `ss -s` and `ss -tan | grep TIME-WAIT | wc -l`
eli: For the Java client the keepalive props are `http.keepAlive=true` and `http.maxConnections` — re-enable and set `maxConnections` to a sane default (50).
lina: Rollback deployed (sha: a1b2c3d). Re-enabled keepalive and set maxConnections=50.
derrick: I'll open a ticket to provision a second NATGW per AZ for high-traffic clusters. We'll need to weigh the cost vs. improving pooling and caching.
sanjay: Any immediate change in traffic?
maya: Within 6 minutes after rollback TIME_WAIT dropped by ~30% on affected nodes. NATGW ephemeral usage down to ~62% on nat-0a1b2c3d. Errors reduced.
sanjay: Nice. Let's keep this incident open until we confirm stabilization for 2 hours.
derrick: Long-term plan notes: (a) egress proxy sidecar (envoy/haproxy) for connection pooling and circuit-breaking; (b) node-local model cache to avoid repeated pulls; (c) replicate model registry in-region to reduce cross-subnet egress; (d) provision multi-nat per AZ for blast radius.
eli: Also add automated alerts when NAT ephemeral > 75% and conntrack usage > 70% so we act preemptively.
lina: I'll add the alert and a playbook snippet to runbook.
ops-bot: INC-4821 status -> mitigated, monitoring.
sanjay: Thanks everyone. Postmortem follow-ups: lina/dderrick implement alerts & multi-nat plan, eng-infra prototype sidecar pool, infra-research look into conn reuse libs.
maya: I'll keep monitoring metrics and post graphs in 30m.
sanjay: Closing thread for now but keeping incident open until end of window. Good catch on that config change — worth a blameless PM to prevent similar fallout.
